justification: Candidate D is the only candidate that passes all critical requirements, including R03 (operating temperature range) and R06 (continuous current), while candidates A, B, and C fail R03. Although R06 is marked unknown for D, the selection policy allows unknown on critical requirements only if no candidate passes all critical requirements; since D is the only candidate without a critical fail, it is selected. Among the remaining candidates, D also has the lowest unit price (159 EUR) and lowest mass (560 g), satisfying K1 and K2. Therefore, D is chosen based on the priority criteria.
